moment: The start-of-term feast in the Great Hall at Hogwarts
title: An Ogre at Hogwarts
story: Hufflepuff values loyalty, patience, and apparently second helpings. Shrek has found his people—and their roast potatoes.
world: The start-of-term feast fills Hogwarts’ Great Hall with floating candles, clattering goblets, and suspiciously hungry students. Find the unexpected guest before he eats the Hufflepuff table out of house and home.

characters.name: Shrek
quips: Pass the potatoes, not the prophecy.
Your sorting hat better not touch my onions.
I'm only staying until dessert. Probably.
characters.line: Finally, a school that understands the importance of dinner.

characters.name: Harry Potter
quips: One normal feast. That's all I ask.
Has anyone seen Hedwig?
Ron, leave some for everyone else.
characters.line: Not me. My scar isn't ogre-shaped.

characters.name: Hermione Granger
quips: I've read about ogres, actually.
That's not proper table etiquette.
The answer is plainly over there.
characters.line: Honestly, do I look like an ogre?

characters.name: Ron Weasley
quips: Blimey, he can put it away.
Save me a drumstick!
Mum would need a bigger saucepan.
characters.line: I'm ginger, not green. Keep looking.

characters.name: Minerva McGonagall
quips: No swamp mud on the benches.
Manners are not optional.
An unusual addition to the register.
characters.line: Certainly not. Kindly observe more carefully.

characters.name: Albus Dumbledore
quips: All appetites are welcome here.
Perhaps we should order more pudding.
A most delightfully unexpected guest.
characters.line: No ogre here. Merely an old headmaster.

characters.name: Severus Snape
quips: Do stop staring.
This feast grows increasingly intolerable.
Keep those onions out of my classroom.
characters.line: Your powers of observation remain... disappointing.

hint.text: Look along the yellow-and-black table, beside a very well-loaded plate.
